description: This is a test source file for the PowerSaving component of the AnySoftKeyboard project, containing unit tests for power saving modes, battery states, and related behaviors using Robolectric and Mockito.

classes.name: PowerSavingTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class for testing the PowerSaving component's behavior in various scenarios.

methods.name: testValuesArray
methods.description: Tests that the resource array for power save mode values contains the expected entries.

methods.name: testLifeCycle
methods.description: Verifies that the broadcast receivers for battery low and okay intents are registered and unregistered appropriately during the power saving state observation lifecycle.

methods.name: testNeverPowerSavingMode
methods.description: Checks that when the power save mode is set to 'never', the power saving state remains false regardless of battery state changes.

methods.name: testAlwaysPowerSavingMode
methods.description: Checks that when the power save mode is set to 'always', the power saving state remains true regardless of battery state changes.

methods.name: testWhenLowPowerSavingMode
methods.description: Verifies that in low power saving mode, the power saving state toggles correctly with battery and charging state changes.

methods.name: testControlledByEnabledPref
methods.description: Tests that the power saving state responds correctly to user preferences for sound control and battery state.

methods.name: testControlledByEnabledPrefDefaultFalse
methods.description: Ensures that default preferences set to false correctly influence the power saving state.

methods.name: testWhenLowPowerSavingModeWithDevicePowerSavingState
methods.description: Tests the interaction between device-level power saving mode (API 21+) and the app's power saving logic.

methods.name: sendBatteryState
methods.description: Simulates a change in battery state by broadcasting the appropriate intent.

methods.name: sendChargingState
methods.description: Simulates a change in charging state by broadcasting the appropriate intent.

methods.name: sendPowerSavingState
methods.description: Simulates a change in device power saving mode using ShadowPowerManager.
